Promote a working meeting draft into a durable dated note, preserving the repository's established location, naming, and template conventions and resetting the draft only after the final note is safely written. Use when a user asks to archive, finalize, file, or promote meeting notes from a draft such as `.docs/meetings/_draft.md`.

## Use this skill

```text
arcantry skills link promote-meeting-notes
```

## Examples

### Archive the current meeting draft

**Prompt**

> Use $promote-meeting-notes to finalize .docs/meetings/_draft.md using this repository's existing note format.

**Expected outcome**

One dated durable note with decisions and follow-ups preserved, followed by a safely reset working draft.

### Resolve an ambiguous meeting date

**Prompt**

> Use $promote-meeting-notes on this draft, but ask before writing if the date or destination cannot be derived safely.

**Expected outcome**

A focused clarification instead of a misfiled or overwritten note, with prior meeting records left unchanged.
